Regentatlantic Capital Increases Holding in Apple (AAPL); Dorian Lpg LTD (LPG) Holder Oceanic Investment Management LTD Trimmed Stake
May 15, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson
Oceanic Investment Management Ltd decreased its stake in Dorian Lpg Ltd (LPG) by 34.47% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Oceanic Investment Management Ltd sold 276,609 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.74% with the market. The hedge fund held 525,938 shares of the marine transportation company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.32 million, down from 802,547 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Oceanic Investment Management Ltd who had been investing in Dorian Lpg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $397.32M market cap company. The stock decreased 0.83% or $0.06 during the last trading session, reaching $7.21. About 70,850 shares traded. Dorian LPG Ltd. (NYSE:LPG) has declined 23.80% since May 15, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 35.35% the S&P500.
Regentatlantic Capital Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 4.39% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Regentatlantic Capital Llc bought 9,112 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 216,675 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $36.67 million, up from 207,563 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Regentatlantic Capital Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $924.78 billion market cap company.
